title: Filtering, Search, Sorting & Pagination
outcome: Implement scalable list endpoints with validated filtering/search/sorting/pagination and deterministic database queries.
artifact: Task list API with filter/search/sort/page contract plus metadata and indexes justified by measured query patterns.
labSteps: Write the query contract including defaults and maximum page size.
Whitelist sortable fields and directions instead of interpolating arbitrary user input.
Implement filters and text search with clearly defined case/field semantics.
Start with offset pagination, then explain where cursor pagination changes consistency/performance.
Guarantee deterministic ordering with a unique tie-breaker.
Inspect representative query plans/index needs rather than indexing every field.
failureModes: Client sends database column names unchecked
Counting/filtering with different predicates so metadata lies
mastery: Can design a stable list contract
Can explain offset vs cursor tradeoffs
Can connect indexes to actual query patterns
principles: Filtering, sorting, and pagination must use deterministic query rules so results remain stable.
Validate user-supplied sort fields instead of injecting arbitrary column names into queries.
Pagination metadata should match the strategy used by the API so clients can navigate correctly.
Indexes should follow real filter and sort patterns when performance data shows they are needed.
